summary: Join our training course on capital allocation and strategic decision-making. Gain essential skills to optimize resources and elevate your strategic thinking.
lede: Capital allocation and strategic decision-making helps you compare competing investments through NPV, IRR, ROIC, real options thinking, and scenario analysis. You will learn to weigh strategic alignment, opportunity cost, funding constraints, and uncertainty when deciding which initiatives should move forward. The course develops practical skills for evaluating proposals, ranking priorities, challenging assumptions, and building executive-ready business cases. You will also explore capital request scorecards, portfolio mapping, post-investment review, and AI-assisted planning workflows at a practical level, so funding decisions can be transparent, repeatable, and trusted by senior stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate funding requests, shape investment priorities, and defend capital decisions across finance, strategy, and operations. It is especially relevant when you need capital allocation and strategic decision-making to be consistent, evidence-based, and aligned with organizational goals.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of financial statements, basic budgeting concepts, and how projects are approved in your organization. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable using spreadsheets for investment appraisal, scenario analysis, and capital request evaluation. Familiarity with NPV, IRR, or ROI is helpful but not essential, and advanced capital allocation concepts are taught at an operational level rather than as theory alone.
